day_shape: 50 items dominated by regime-channel Journalist Day messaging and Pezeshkian/IRGC statements tying Strait of Hormuz reopening to US concessions, a reported maritime incident 18nm off Khusab, Oman, and a JPost report on US Gen. Caine seeking an Iran-war off-ramp; nothing from UK Parliament, State Department or OFAC.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz conditions and Oman talks
threads.summary: IRGC spokesman Mohbati and Foreign Minister Araghchi said on regime channels that reopening the Strait of Hormuz is conditional on US acceptance of Iran's terms, while Oman negotiations continue. The SNSC secretary said via IRIB that the strait will not open 'until America corrects its conduct'; Araghchi said Tehran is 'very close' to an Oman agreement.

threads.label: Maritime incident off Oman coast
threads.summary: Defa Press and IRIB relayed a UKMTO report of an incident 18 nautical miles east of Khusab, Oman, with a projectile causing a fire aboard a vessel. Both regime outlets cited the UK Maritime Trade Operations organisation as the source.

threads.label: Reported US Joint Chiefs off-ramp search
threads.summary: The Jerusalem Post reported that US Chairman of the Joint Chiefs Gen. Dan Caine has been seeking an off-ramp in the Iran war over escalation concerns. Defa Press amplified the same account, framing Caine as pressing Trump for a diplomatic exit while avoiding appearing weak.

threads.label: Journalist Day messaging cycle
threads.summary: Regime outlets ran heavy Journalist Day content, with statements from Khamenei, judiciary chief Ezzati, parliament speaker Qalibaf, the General Staff and IRGC praising 'revolutionary media' and wartime coverage. IRIB officials said over 50 journalists reported through the war and that broadcasts ran from 7 locations under bombardment.

threads.label: Iran domestic crackdown and dissent
threads.summary: Iran International and Jerusalem Post reported on Iran's continuing executions, arrests on national-security grounds, the summoning of cleric Mohammad-Bagher Kharrazi for calling to replace the Islamic Republic with an 'Islamic government', and the reported abduction and killing of pro-establishment singer Hamidreza Rajabzadeh. Iran International also reported nearly one million people dropped off social security rolls in the past year.
